articles.title: MIT's Robotic Insect Learns Backflips with AI, Gets 450% Faster
articles.summary: MIT's tiny flying robot now uses AI to perform flips and fly 450% faster. It could one day help search for survivors in collapsed buildings.

articles.title: Beyond Dinosaurs: Five Ways the Mesozoic Earth Was Alien
articles.summary: No grass, no ice caps, and a supercontinent—the dinosaur era was radically different from our world, even without the dinosaurs.

articles.title: Trace Fossils: The Stories Ancient Animals Left in Stone
articles.summary: Footprints, burrows, and fossilized poop are trace fossils—clues that reveal how ancient creatures lived, not just what they looked like.
